title: Perfume
author: Patrick Süskind
summary: Born with no scent of his own but an extraordinary sense of smell, Jean-Baptiste Grenouille grows up in eighteenth-century France obsessed with capturing the perfect scent, and willing to kill to do it.
readIf: you want a strange, lush, grotesque fable with a chilling antihero and rich sensory writing.
skipIf: you want a protagonist with any empathy, or violence against young women is a line for you.

pairings.reason: Another story that looks closely at a killer's mind, though as a faster thriller.
A classic about beauty and moral decay, in more elegant, less grotesque form.
Another European novel built on atmosphere and obsession, with more warmth.
